sentences: Prepare ingredients for Angie's Dad's Best Cabbage Coleslaw: cabbage, onion, carrot, celery, white sugar, white vinegar, vegetable oil, salt, mustard, black pepper.

Step 1 of Angie's Dad's Best Cabbage Coleslaw: In a large bowl, combine cabbage, onion, carrots, and celery. Sprinkle with 1 cup sugar, and mix well. In a small saucepan, combine vinegar, oil, salt, dry mustard, and pepper. Bring to a boil. Pour hot dressing over cabbage mixture, and mix well..
Prepare ingredients for Appalachian Slaw: cabbage, tomato, cucumber, onion, sugar, salt, black pepper, mayonnaise.
Step 1 of Appalachian Slaw: In a large bowl, stir together the cabbage, tomato, cucumber, onion, sugar, salt, pepper and mayonnaise. Add additional mayonnaise to suit your taste..
Prepare ingredients for Best-Ever Cucumber Dill Salad: cucumber, salt black pepper, sour cream, vinegar, yogurt, mayonnaise, lime, white sugar, dill, onion, celery.
Step 1 of Best-Ever Cucumber Dill Salad: Gather all ingredients..

Step 2 of Best-Ever Cucumber Dill Salad: Place cucumber slices in a colander. Generously sprinkle salt over cucumber; let sit until water starts to bead on the slices, about 10 minutes. Drain water from cucumber slices..
Step 3 of Best-Ever Cucumber Dill Salad: Whisk sour cream, vinegar, yogurt, mayonnaise, lime juice, sugar, and dill together in a large bowl until dressing is smooth..
Step 4 of Best-Ever Cucumber Dill Salad: Mix cucumber, onion, and celery into dressing until evenly coated; season with salt and pepper..
Prepare ingredients for California Coleslaw: cabbage, onion, bell pepper, carrot, cider vinegar, white sugar, salt, freshly black pepper, vegetable oil.

Step 1 of California Coleslaw: In a large salad bowl, place the cabbage, onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper and carrot. Combine the vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper and vegetable oil in the bowl with the vegetables. Toss the mixture until the vegetables are fully coated with the marinade..
Prepare ingredients for Claremont Salad: cabbage, cucumber, carrot, bermuda onion, distilled white vinegar, white sugar, vegetable oil, water, salt.
Step 1 of Claremont Salad: Combine cabbage, cucumbers, carrots, and onion in a large bowl..

Step 2 of Claremont Salad: Whisk together vinegar, sugar, oil, water, and salt in a small bowl. Pour over the cabbage mixture, toss to coat, and refrigerate for at least 12 hours. Drain excess liquid before serving..

cucumber_and_tomato_salad_with_mayo.recipe_name: Cucumber and Tomato Salad with Mayo
sentences: Prepare ingredients for Cucumber and Tomato Salad with Mayo: tomato, cucumber, onion, mayonnaise, clov garlic, black pepper, salt.
Step 1 of Cucumber and Tomato Salad with Mayo: Toss together tomatoes, cucumber, onion, mayonnaise, and garlic in a large serving bowl. Season with pepper and salt..
Prepare ingredients for Cucumber Pasta Salad: bow tie pasta, cucumber, onion, dill, white vinegar, white sugar, water, vegetable oil, prepared mustard, salt, black pepper.

Step 1 of Cucumber Pasta Salad: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain and rinse several times with cold water until pasta is cool..
Step 2 of Cucumber Pasta Salad: Stir pasta, cucumber, onion, and dill in a salad bowl..

Step 3 of Cucumber Pasta Salad: Whisk vinegar, sugar, water, vegetable oil, mustard, salt, and black pepper in a separate bowl until sugar and salt have dissolved. Pour dressing over pasta mixture and toss lightly to coat with dressing. Let chill for 2 hours before serving..
Prepare ingredients for Cucumber Salad: cucumber, onion, white vinegar, white sugar, water, dill.
Step 1 of Cucumber Salad: Gather the ingredients..
Step 2 of Cucumber Salad: Toss sliced cucumbers and onion together in a large bowl. Set aside..

Step 3 of Cucumber Salad: Combine vinegar, sugar, and water in a saucepan over medium-high heat; bring to a boil; pour over cucumbers and onions in the bowl. Stir in dill. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving..
Prepare ingredients for Cucumber Salad With Sour Cream: cucumber, container sour cream, white sugar, distilled white vinegar, salt black pepper.
Step 1 of Cucumber Salad With Sour Cream: Place cucumber slices in a container and cover with cold water. Refrigerate 4 hours to overnight..
Step 2 of Cucumber Salad With Sour Cream: Whisk sour cream, sugar, vinegar, and salt together in a large bowl until sugar dissolves..
Step 3 of Cucumber Salad With Sour Cream: Drain cucumbers well and pat dry with paper towels. Add cucumbers to sour cream dressing and toss to coat..
Prepare ingredients for Cucumber Slices with Dill: cucumber, onion, dill weed, white sugar, white vinegar, water, salt.
Step 1 of Cucumber Slices with Dill: Combine cucumbers, onion, and dill in a large serving bowl..
Step 2 of Cucumber Slices with Dill: Combine sugar, vinegar, water, and salt in a medium bowl; stir until sugar dissolves..
Step 3 of Cucumber Slices with Dill: Pour vinegar mixture over cucumber mixture. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

cucumber_tomato_and_red_onion_salad.recipe_name: Cucumber, Tomato, and Red Onion Salad
sentences: Prepare ingredients for Cucumber, Tomato, and Red Onion Salad: tomato, cucumber, onion, coriander, lime, salt.
Step 1 of Cucumber, Tomato, and Red Onion Salad: Mix tomatoes, cucumbers, red onion, cilantro, and lime juice together in a bowl. Season with salt and serve..
Prepare ingredients for Cucumber Tomato Salad: water, distilled white vinegar, vegetable oil, sugar, salt, freshly black pepper, cucumber, tomato, onion.
Step 1 of Cucumber Tomato Salad: Gather all ingredients..
Step 2 of Cucumber Tomato Salad: Whisk water, vinegar, oil, sugar, salt, and pepper together in a large bowl until smooth..
Step 3 of Cucumber Tomato Salad: Add cucumbers, tomatoes, and onion and stir to coat..
Step 4 of Cucumber Tomato Salad: Cover bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate for at least 2 hours for best flavor results..
Step 5 of Cucumber Tomato Salad: Enjoy!.
Prepare ingredients for Easy Coleslaw: cabbage, bell pepper, onion, carrot, white wine vinegar, vegetable oil, white sugar.
Step 1 of Easy Coleslaw: Combine cabbage, bell pepper, onion, and carrots in a large bowl..
Step 2 of Easy Coleslaw: Whisk together vinegar, oil, and sugar in a medium bowl. Pour enough dressing over cabbage mixture to coat; mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 6 to 8 hours..
Step 3 of Easy Coleslaw: Drain any excess liquid, toss, and serve cold..
Prepare ingredients for Freezer Slaw: cabbage, bell pepper, onion, carrot, boiling water, salt, white sugar, water, cider vinegar, celery seed.

Step 1 of Freezer Slaw: Combine cabbage, green bell pepper, onion, and carrots in a large bowl. Mix boiling water and salt together in a separate bowl and pour over cabbage mixture; set aside for salt to draw out extra water from vegetables, about 1 hour. Drain well..

Step 2 of Freezer Slaw: Mix sugar, 1 cup water, cider vinegar, and celery seed in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved, about 1 minute. Remove the saucepan from the heat and cool completely..

Step 3 of Freezer Slaw: Pour cooled sugar-vinegar mixture over drained cabbage mixture in a large bowl and toss until slaw is well mixed. Spoon slaw into resealable plastic bags; squeeze out excess air, seal the bag, and freeze..
Prepare ingredients for Fresh Frozen Cucumbers: cucumber, salt, white sugar, distilled white vinegar.
Step 1 of Fresh Frozen Cucumbers: Place cucumbers into a large bowl and sprinkle with salt. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours..

Step 2 of Fresh Frozen Cucumbers: Rinse and drain cucumbers, pressing out as much water as possible. Place cucumbers back into the bowl and stir in sugar and vinegar until well combined. Cover and refrigerate for 24 more hours. Transfer to a freezer container and freeze..
Prepare ingredients for Lemony Cucumbers: cucumber, white wine vinegar, onion, white sugar, lemon juice, celery seed, salt, black pepper.
Step 1 of Lemony Cucumbers: Toss cucumbers, vinegar, chopped onion, sugar, lemon juice, celery seeds, salt, and black pepper in a bowl until combined; cover. Chill in the refrigerator, 4 hours..
Prepare ingredients for Lower-Fat Coleslaw: mayonnaise, milk, white vinegar, apple cider vinegar, lemon juice, white sugar, salt, cabbage, onion, carrot.

Step 1 of Lower-Fat Coleslaw: Whisk mayonnaise, low-fat milk, white vinegar, apple cider vinegar, lemon juice, sugar, and salt together in a bowl and allow dressing to stand while preparing vegetables, about 20 minutes..
Step 2 of Lower-Fat Coleslaw: Pour dressing over cabbage, onion, and carrot in a large salad bowl and toss to combine. For best flavor, refrigerate slaw at least 2 hours to overnight..
Prepare ingredients for Mizeria (Polish Cucumber Salad): cucumber, salt, dill, sour cream, lemon juice, white sugar, black pepper.

Step 1 of Mizeria (Polish Cucumber Salad): Place cucumbers into a colander and sprinkle generously with salt; let stand until soft, about 5 minutes. Squeeze liquid from cucumbers and transfer to a bowl with dill..

Step 2 of Mizeria (Polish Cucumber Salad): Mix sour cream, lemon juice, and sugar together in a bowl; add to cucumbers and toss to coat. Season with pepper. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes before serving..
Prepare ingredients for Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: ounc elbow macaroni, carrot, onion, bell pepper, celery, mayonnaise, condensed milk, white sugar, white vinegar, salt pepper.
Step 1 of Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: Gather all ingredients..

Step 2 of Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Rinse under cold water; drain and set aside..

Step 3 of Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: Stir together carrots, red onion, bell peppers, and celery in a large serving bowl. Mix in mayonnaise, condensed milk, sugar, vinegar, salt, and pepper until well combined..
Step 4 of Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: Add macaroni; toss gently, then cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours..
Step 5 of Mom's Best Macaroni Salad: Enjoy!.
Prepare ingredients for Mom's Marinated Cucumbers: cucumber, salt, white sugar, distilled white vinegar, onion, water, celery seed.
Step 1 of Mom's Marinated Cucumbers: Peel cucumbers and slice wafer-thin; sprinkle with salt. Let stand for 30 minutes, then squeeze cucumbers to release moisture..
Step 2 of Mom's Marinated Cucumbers: Mix sugar, vinegar, onion, water, and celery seed together in a medium bowl until well combined. Add cucumbers and stir until evenly coated..
Step 3 of Mom's Marinated Cucumbers: Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour..

Prepare ingredients for Mostaccioli Salad: mostaccioli pasta, vegetable oil, distilled white vinegar, white sugar, onion, cucumber, pimento, prepared yellow mustard, garlic powder, parsley flak, salt, black pepper.
Step 1 of Mostaccioli Salad: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain..

Step 2 of Mostaccioli Salad: In a large bowl, gently toss together the pasta, oil, vinegar, sugar, onion, cucumber, pimento, mustard, garlic powder, parsley flakes, salt, and pepper. Cover, and refrigerate 24 hours before serving..
Prepare ingredients for New Jersey Diner Salad: cabbage, onion, carrot, bell pepper, cucumber, vinegar, vegetable oil, white sugar, salt.

Step 1 of New Jersey Diner Salad: In a large bowl, toss together the cabbage, onions, carrot, pepper, and cucumber. In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, oil, sugar, and salt. Pour the dressing over the salad, and stir to coat. Cover tightly, and refrigerate overnight before serving..
Prepare ingredients for Shiraz Salad: cucumber, tomato, onion, lemon juice, mint, salt black pepper.
Step 1 of Shiraz Salad: Mix cucumbers, tomato, onion, lemon juice, mint, salt, and pepper together in a bowl..
Prepare ingredients for Spicy Southwestern Slaw: cabbage, carrot, onion, bell pepper, jalapeno pepper, coriander, canola oil, apple cider vinegar, white sugar, cayenne pepper, salt pepper.
Step 1 of Spicy Southwestern Slaw: In a large bowl, toss together the cabbage, carrot, onion, red pepper, jalapeno and cilantro. Set aside..

Step 2 of Spicy Southwestern Slaw: In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, sugar, cayenne pepper, salt and pepper. Pour over vegetable mixture and toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour..
Prepare ingredients for Summer Radish Salad: radish, salt, onion, cucumber, olive oil, white wine vinegar, dill, garlic, white sugar.
Step 1 of Summer Radish Salad: Toss radishes with salt; let stand for about 10 minutes. Drain any liquid and transfer radishes to a large bowl; add red onion and cucumber slices..

Step 2 of Summer Radish Salad: Whisk olive oil, vinegar, dill, garlic, and sugar together in a small bowl until well mixed; pour over vegetables and toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving..

sweet_and_tangy_thai_cucumber_salad.recipe_name: Sweet and Tangy Thai Cucumber Salad
sentences: Prepare ingredients for Sweet and Tangy Thai Cucumber Salad: white sugar, water, distilled white vinegar, salt, cucumber, onion.

Step 1 of Sweet and Tangy Thai Cucumber Salad: Whisk sugar, hot water, vinegar, and salt together in a bowl until sugar dissolved; stir in cucumber and onion. Refrigerate at least 1 hour to soften vegetables and reduce onion pungency..
Prepare ingredients for Tomato and Pepper Salad: tomato, cucumber, bell pepper, celery, distilled white vinegar, white sugar, salt, freshly black pepper.
Step 1 of Tomato and Pepper Salad: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, green bell pepper, and celery in a bowl..
Step 2 of Tomato and Pepper Salad: Mix vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in a separate bowl and pour over salad. Gently toss to coat..
Step 3 of Tomato and Pepper Salad: Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally..
Prepare ingredients for Tomato Cucumber Onion Salad: cucumber, tomato, olive oil, red wine vinegar, onion, white pepper, salt.

Step 1 of Tomato Cucumber Onion Salad: Toss together cucumber, tomato, olive oil, red wine vinegar, red onion, and white pepper in a large serving bowl; season with salt. Refrigerate until slightly chilled, 10 to 15 minutes..
Prepare ingredients for Tomato Cucumber Salad: tomato, cucumber, onion, lemon juice, salt black peper.
Step 1 of Tomato Cucumber Salad: Gather all ingredients..
Step 2 of Tomato Cucumber Salad: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, and onion in a salad bowl. Sprinkle with lemon juice and season with salt and black pepper; toss until well combined..
Step 3 of Tomato Cucumber Salad: Cover and chill salad in the refrigerator until ready to serve..
Prepare ingredients for Tomato Cucumber Salad with Mint: red wine vinegar, white sugar, salt, cucumber, tomato, onion, mint, olive oil, salt pepper.
Step 1 of Tomato Cucumber Salad with Mint: In a large bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt. Mix in cucumbers, and marinate 1 hour, stirring occasionally..
Step 2 of Tomato Cucumber Salad with Mint: Gently toss tomatoes, onion, mint, and olive oil with the marinated cucumbers. Season with salt and pepper..
